title: Edits: Video Editor
description:
Edits is a free video editor that makes it easy for creators to turn their ideas into videos, right on their phone. It has all the tools you need to support your creation process, all in one place.

Simplify your creative process

- Export your videos in 4K with no watermark and share to any platform.
- Keep track of all your drafts and videos in one place.
- Capture high-quality clips up to 10 minutes long and start editing right away.
- Easily share to Instagram with high-quality playback. 

Create and edit with powerful tools

- Edit videos with single-frame precision.
- Get the look you want with camera settings for resolution, frame rate and dynamic range, plus upgraded flash and zoom controls.
- Bring images to life with AI animation.
- Change up your background using green screen, cutout or add a video overlay.
- Choose from a variety of fonts, sound and voice effects, video filters and effects, stickers and more.
- Enhance audio to make voices clearer and remove background noise.
- Generate captions automatically and customize how they appear in your video.

Inform your next creative decisions

- Get inspired by browsing reels with trending audio. 
- Keep track of ideas and content you’re excited by until you're ready to create.
- Track how your reels are performing with a live insights dashboard.
- Understand what affects your reels engagement.
recentChanges:
• More caption control. Font size and letter spacing, plus a preview you can play without leaving the editor.
• Better stability and performance across the board. Fewer crashes and smoother exports.
